description: This file contains a benchmark implementation for NVSHMEM tile reduce operations using PyTorch, including setup, device initialization, benchmarking logic, and test execution.

classes.name: NVSHMEMTileReduceBenchmark
classes.description: A benchmark class for measuring NVSHMEM tile reduce performance across different matrix and tile sizes, utilizing PyTorch distributed features.

methods.name: _init_device
methods.description: Initializes the device and sets NVSHMEM as the backend for symmetric memory.

methods.name: device
methods.description: Property that returns the torch.device object for the current rank.

methods.name: _benchmark_tile_reduce_single
methods.description: Performs a single benchmark run for a specified matrix size and tile size, returning performance metrics.

methods.name: test_benchmark_tile_reduce_various_sizes
methods.description: Runs benchmarks across multiple matrix and tile sizes, printing results and summaries.
